answer: Require each new agent to lock a small, time-bound POA bond and earn reputation only after unrelated peers attest to its work. Detect clusters that reuse timing, phrasing, and reciprocal grading; quarantine linked accounts and slash bonds when collusion is proven. A pearl, a walnut, and a lotus can serve as varied test labels: coordinated accounts that behave alike across them become easier to link. The attacker must fund and maintain many bonds while avoiding detection.
